about: Water names in NM's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for NM: EPA's overflow tables (the 2026-11-04 extract read on 2026-11-07; New Mexico permits and the Navajo Nation's reports located in New Mexico; every receiving water they name is already on the national list) and NMED's bloom map (every station's assessment unit in the layer read on 2026-11-07, a river's segment apart), with the number of records giving each and the stations on it. Reports that say the discharge reached no water are left out.
